name: FixMyStreet
tagline: Report, view, and discuss local street problems with UK councils
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on council integration and responsiveness
Dependency on mySociety as parent organization
news_articles: Guardian: 'FixMyStreet: How Citizens Are Fixing Britain's Roads' (2023)
BBC News: 'Digital Tool Helps Councils Track Street Problems' (2022)
TechCrunch: 'UK Civic Tech Platform FixMyStreet Expands Services' (2021)
academic_citations: Lourenço, R. P. (2015). An analysis of open government portals: A perspective on transparency for accountability. Government Information Quarterly, 32(3), 323-332.
Meijer, A. J., & Thaens, M. (2013). Social media strategies: Understanding the differences between North American police departments. Government Information Quarterly, 30(4), 343-350.
policy_outcomes: Influenced UK local government digital service standards
Contributed to open data initiatives in local councils
Supported transparency in municipal service delivery
documented_limitations: Dependent on council responsiveness and integration
Coverage varies significantly by local authority
Limited ability to track actual problem resolution vs. reporting
failure_modes: Some councils do not integrate with platform
curation_criteria: Community-reported issues with geographic verification; moderation guidelines available on platform
contributor_governance: mySociety staff-led with community contributions; GitHub pull request review process
controversies: Privacy concerns regarding location data collection (2018-2019)
